text_or_event: A tiny speck of light.
It's about to make the longest commute in the solar system.
It was born here, in the heart of the Sun.
Fifteen million degrees...
...and very, very crowded.
Every time it tries to leave, it bumps into something.
Boing! Off in a random direction.
evidence: 同上；与画面拟声字同帧

text_or_event: Boing! And again. And again.
It's like trying to leave a party,
where everybody wants to say goodbye.
It keeps this up for a hundred thousand years.
While it bounces, the mammoths vanish,
the first cities rise,
and somebody builds the pyramids.
Near the top, the Sun gives it a lift.
A great, boiling elevator.
And then... Pop!
Out here, there's nothing in the way.
A hundred and fifty million kilometres,
in eight minutes and twenty seconds.
Not one single bump.
And after all that wandering,
It lands, right here.
In your eye.
So next time the sun warms your face,
say hi.
It came a very long way.
